findings.message: `client_name` comes from the client and is interpolated into a shell command run with `shell=True`. A name such as `x; rm -rf ~` runs arbitrary commands on the server.
findings.suggestion: subprocess.run(["convert", str(UPLOAD_DIR / client_name), "-resize", "128x128", str(UPLOAD_DIR / target)], check=True)

findings.message: `client_name` is not validated, so a value like `../../etc/passwd` reads files outside `UPLOAD_DIR` and writes the thumbnail outside it too. A name starting with `-` would also be read by ImageMagick as an option. Reject names with path separators or a leading dash, or resolve the path and check it stays under `UPLOAD_DIR`.
This new behaviour comes without any test, which the contributing guide requires for every change in behaviour.
